title: Artisan Pack Manifest
description: An Artisan pack manifest: a unit of export and import that groups related menus, templates, commands, translations and assets. It sits at the root of a .itfz (zip) archive.

id.description: Pack id: lowercase letters, digits, - and _. Unique per author.

name.description: Name shown in the dashboard and the marketplace.

description.description: Short description for the marketplace and the import.

version.description: Semver version (X.Y.Z), bumped on each export.

license.description: The pack's licence (an SPDX id such as MIT, CC-BY-NC-4.0, Apache-2.0).

homepage.description: Optional URL of a page about the pack.

tags.description: Tags for the marketplace's categories and search.

artisan_min_version.description: Minimum Artisan version the pack needs.

preview_image.description: Path of a preview image in the archive (e.g. "preview.png"), for the marketplace.

menus.description: Ids of the menus in the pack; each has a menus/<id>.json file in the archive.

templates.description: Ids of the templates in the pack; each has a templates/<id>.json file.

commands.description: Ids of the commands in the pack; each has a commands/<id>.json file following command/v1.

translations.description: The translations in the pack: the keys its menus and commands reference, computed on export.

file.description: Path of the translations file in the archive (default "translations.json"), following translations/v1.

key_count.description: Number of keys included (shown on import).

languages.description: Languages the pack's translations cover, so the import can warn about missing ones.

assets.description: Paths of the included assets (relative to the archive's assets/ folder).

requires_plugins.description: Third-party plugins the pack needs (e.g. "luckperms", "vault"). Computed on export.
